name.description: Full name, as it should appear on the card.

team.description: Which team's keychain the card hangs on.

role.description: Shown under the name. A role starting with "VP" hangs first on its team.

emoji.description: One emoji for the badge on the card. null shows a PMC gear.

photo.description: A square image in public/team (just the file name, e.g. "jane-doe.webp") or a full https:// URL. null shows initials.

url.description: Where clicking the card goes: LinkedIn, a portfolio, a personal site. null makes the card not clickable.

order.description: Position within the team, lowest first (after the VP).
